label: Google (all APIs)
description: One connection for several Google APIs — prefer the dedicated Gmail, Calendar, Drive… entries
agentGuide: Paths relative to https://www.googleapis.com. Gmail: GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages?q=is:unread&maxResults=10 then GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages/<id> for the detail (the list only returns identifiers). Calendar: GET /calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?timeMin=<ISO>&singleEvents=true&orderBy=startTime. Drive: GET /drive/v3/files?q=name contains '…'. Sheets: GET /sheets/v4/spreadsheets/<id>/values/<range>. You are bound to the scopes granted to the connection: a 403 means the scope is missing, not that you are going about it wrong.
